title: Equity Brief — 17 Aug 2026
intro: Markets trade in TRANSITIONAL regime with VIX at 14.97 signaling low volatility as divergence emerges between resilient tech (Nvidia +4.12% weekly) and weakness in mega-cap internet platforms. Session driver is sector rotation with Nikkei strength and European consumer discretionary pressure offsetting mixed US tech earnings reactions.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
Nikkei 225: 68,714 +2.60% weekly — Japanese exporters benefit from stable yen and semiconductor supply chain strength
Russell 2000: 3,058.41 +1.03% weekly — Domestic small caps outperform on Fed pause expectations
Nasdaq: 26,756 +1.18% weekly — Chipmakers lift index despite FAANG drag
S&P 500: 5,775.36 +0.62% weekly — Breadth narrows as leadership concentrates
DAX: 26,391 -0.00% weekly — German industrials flat amid China demand concerns
CAC 40: 8,583 -1.52% weekly — French luxury and consumer sectors underperform
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 5,775 holding above 5,750 support with neutral bias as 7 of 11 sectors decline; catalyst is Wednesday retail sales data testing consumer resilience narrative.
Nasdaq 26,756 shows relative strength on semiconductor momentum but faces resistance at 26,900; options flow suggests hedging into Jackson Hole symposium Friday.
Dow 53,525 weakest major index down 0.50% weekly as industrials and financials lag; break below 53,400 would signal broadening weakness.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 26,391 unchanged weekly in tight consolidation as auto sector weakness offsets SAP strength ahead of Thursday PMI releases.
FTSE 100 at 10,735 down 1.01% weekly pressured by energy sector decline and sterling strength weighing on exporters.
CAC 40 weakest at 8,583 down 1.52% as LVMH and Hermes slide on China luxury spending slowdown fears.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Nvidia 226.46 +4.12% weekly leads on data center demand acceleration into AI infrastructure build-out with September product launch anticipation building.
Microsoft 483.70 -3.99% weekly underperforms on Azure growth deceleration concerns and profit-taking after enterprise software valuation stretch.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Nvidia 226.50 entry on AI capex cycle continuation, stop 218.00, target 242.00
LONG: Russell 2000 3,060 entry on Fed dovish tilt favoring domestics, stop 3,020, target 3,140
SHORT/AVOID: Meta 573.98 after 4.20% weekly decline suggests advertising slowdown; avoid until 550 support test
